concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-paypal-checkout-with-paypal-javascript-v3]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree JavaScript v3 website route for non-vault one-time PayPal Checkout, client payment-resource creation, approval-to-nonce tokenization and server `Transaction.sale` handoff, with currency/intent matching and optional checkout-module locators; not PayPal Checkout v6, direct PayPal Orders API or payment-outcome proof
warnings: Keep this website guide distinct from separately versioned PayPal Checkout v6 and exact-package GitHub evidence.
Approval and successful tokenization yield a Braintree nonce for server processing; they do not prove authorization, capture, settlement or funding.

Preserve the non-vault flow, JavaScript v3 scope, SDK minimum, currency/intent matching, US-only Contact Module statement and dual-environment shipping-callback registration as snapshot-qualified guidance.
